punchline: Nir Eyal argues that believing your willpower runs out may be exactly what makes you give up.
thirty_sec: Nir Eyal doesn't buy the idea that willpower gets used up. Instead, he says, decide ahead of time, while you're calm. Make the bad habit harder, like blocking certain sites during work hours. Or put a price on slipping. Or make it part of who you are, the way a vegetarian doesn't agonize over meat. Even moving an app off your home screen counts.
question: What's one habit you'd happily make a little harder for yourself to reach?
